column1: # Which price CombatCosts 0.7.1 selects (CostRules.ResolveField, Preference, Value and ParsePrice,
# read from the IL of CombatCosts.dll 74afa902...). Shared by tests/RuntimeTests.cs (CostPolicy, run by
# rule sets and this table together.
# Columns, tab-separated: case, costs, entry, inline, field, inline_field, selected, price.
#   costs   the catalog's [Costs] section; entry: the catalog's [round] section; inline: the unit file's
#           [General] section. "-" means the section is absent, otherwise Key=Value pairs joined by ";"
#           (Key= is a blank value). The reference looked up is "Round", so sections match ignoring case.
#   selected  the raw value chosen: "-" none, "(blank)" an empty value, otherwise the value.
#   price     ParsePrice of it: "unknown", a decimal, or "-" for a category (not a price).
no unit section falls back to the list
missing inline key falls back to the list
blank inline value wins and stays unknown
no list entry keeps the inline value
list-wide: a blank list value wins
list-wide: a missing list key falls back to inline
Override<field> prefers the list for its field
invalid entry bool keeps the list-wide setting
invalid list-wide bool means inline first
blank list-wide bool means inline first
1 is not a bool and keeps the entry setting
CurrentYearCost never falls back to the historical price
a missing inline CurrentYearCost falls back to the list's
the category has its own inline key
